resolution.question: Will Harborview Credit Union's security team approve or reject analyst Dev Patel's software-exception request within their published five-business-day service window?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the security team communicated an approval decision to Dev Patel before the end of the five-business-day window (i.e., by 2026-08-14T17:00:00-08:00, assuming submission on 2026-08-10). Resolve NO if the team communicates a rejection within that window, or if no decision is communicated by the window's end. The hard cutoff of 2026-08-17 is not the deadline; the five-business-day window is the deadline.
